title: Data-Driven Analysis of Text-Conditioning in AI-Generated Music: A Case Study with Suno and Udio
reported_observation: The authors analyze 101,953 songs generated by 60,342 Suno and Udio users between May and October 2024. The corpus includes 81,434 Suno songs. They scrape public new-song playlists, extract prompt/lyrics/tags metadata, embed text with NV-Embed-v2, reduce dimensions with UMAP and cluster with HDBSCAN. They share code and a list of song URLs.
creator_interpretation: This is an unusually valuable empirical foundation for understanding how people use text conditioning at scale, but it is a historical 2024 snapshot and not a direct probe of the private model internals.
our_hypothesis: We can reuse the methodology for community prompt analysis while adding exact prompt syntax, model-era distinctions, audio-linked case coding, lexical novelty and user-authored vs LLM-expanded prompt provenance where available.
limitations: Metadata and excerpt summary from publicly accessible web results; inspect full source before promotion.
Community claims do not reveal proprietary Suno internals.
